Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (Total Governmental Funds, p7-8); roll-forward 1,059,475 + 1,950,548 - 2,515,441 + 3,034,863 - 2,887,731 + 802,695 = 1,444,409 reconciles. Business-type from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (Water + Sewer total, p11); net position roll-forward reconciles with transfers_net -147,132 (transfers in 9,483, out 156,615). No single printed business-type receipts/disbursements total: receipts = operating revenues 309,672 + interest 4,571 + grant 2,812; disbursements = operating expenses 315,893 + interest expense 15,903 (= 331,796, matches p3). Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (pp1-2); long-term debt is not split between principal/other obligations beyond current and noncurrent as printed. ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet 'Cash and cash equivalents (claim on cash)' 897,944 (p5); restricted cash 792,016 and county treasurer cash 27,429 not included. Water and Sewer outflow lines are tagged business-type; other lines are tagged governmental with review where they include utility amounts. All-funds actuals tie: charges plus grants plus interest etc. = 2,323,159; transfers in 3,044,346 = governmental 3,034,863 + water 9,483; transfers out 3,044,346 = governmental 2,887,731 + water 156,615; proceeds 1,062,695 = governmental 802,695 + water 260,000.
